ambiguities.text: FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER is not explicitly specified in the extracted content
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER is defined in the full EIP or accompanying hard fork specification. For modeling, treat it as a known constant.

ambiguities.text: The prediction of 0.1-second delays 'by mid-September' depends on hashrate assumptions not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Treat timeline predictions as approximate. The core mechanism (11.4M block offset) is deterministic; timing depends on actual hashrate.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network hashrate will remain relatively stable, making block time predictions reasonably accurate
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hashrate fluctuations could cause bomb effects to manifest earlier or later than predicted, potentially affecting network usability

implicit_assumptions.description: The 11.4 million block offset provides sufficient delay for planned network upgrades (The Merge)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If The Merge is delayed beyond the bomb activation, another difficulty bomb delay EIP would be needed

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients will implement the fork consistently at the same FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent fork activation could cause chain splits between updated and non-updated clients
